error_text:
ReferenceError: window is not defined
    at render (utils.js:325:201)
root_cause: Browser-only globals like window/localStorage do not exist on the server.
fix: Guard usage: `if (typeof window !== "undefined")`, or move the code into a client-only effect.
title: ReferenceError: window is not defined
